invariants: TOKEN_VAZIO is an auditable state and may not be silently coerced to success
new governance fields are append-only unless an explicit migration exists
scientific claim promotion is forbidden while the parent strong-gravity registry is fail-closed
external evidence requires independent provenance and byte-level custody when used numerically
same-author rerun is reproducibility, not independent replication

six_continuous_evolution_fences.name: authority_and_least_privilege
six_continuous_evolution_fences.rule: Every write, promotion and closure must name the authoritative repository or external authority and must not exceed that authority.
six_continuous_evolution_fences.automatic_check: validator rejects missing authority, owner class or cross-domain claim promotion

six_continuous_evolution_fences.name: append_only_non_regression
six_continuous_evolution_fences.rule: Historical identifiers, field types, evidence states and canonical tokens are preserved unless a versioned migration and compatibility test exist.
six_continuous_evolution_fences.automatic_check: CI validates this mesh and the parent closure registry on every relevant PR/push

six_continuous_evolution_fences.name: claim_and_falsifier_gate
six_continuous_evolution_fences.rule: No hypothesis becomes evidence or claim without a declared falsifier, observable and objective close condition.
six_continuous_evolution_fences.automatic_check: validator requires claim_allowed=false here and preserves parent scientific fail-closed state

six_continuous_evolution_fences.name: rollback_and_reversibility
six_continuous_evolution_fences.rule: Evolution must remain reversible by Git history, branch isolation and bounded changes; destructive mutation is outside this contract.
six_continuous_evolution_fences.automatic_check: workflow runs read-only validation; source mutation is performed only through reviewed commits/PRs

six_continuous_evolution_fences.name: freshness_drift_and_decay_watch
six_continuous_evolution_fences.rule: External metadata, references and open TOKEN_VAZIO states are periodically re-evaluated; stale evidence cannot silently remain current.
six_continuous_evolution_fences.automatic_check: RLL validates on lab changes; Instituto control-plane performs time-based federation watch from its default branch

six_continuous_evolution_fences.name: separation_of_duties_and_independent_replication
six_continuous_evolution_fences.rule: Independent replication cannot be self-issued by the producer; same-author CI remains a separate evidence class.
six_continuous_evolution_fences.automatic_check: validator requires the canonical independent-reproduction protected gap while external receipt is absent

continuous_operation.reason: GitHub scheduled workflows execute from the default branch; RLL governance remains on rll/lab pending explicit maturity promotion.
continuous_operation.institute_time_watch: delegated to instituto-Rafael/RAFAELIA_CORE default-branch assurance workflow

close_rule: A session gap is operationally closed only when it is tracked with urgency, provenance, authority, mechanism, verification, falsifier, custody status and objective close condition. External evidence may remain TOKEN_VAZIO without becoming an untracked gap.
